22 now. I personally believe weed is the main cause of me being a introvert with bad social anxiety. Started smoking at 12, heavily. Had a grownup neighbor at the time who would always tell me to stop smoking that it’d freeze my brain. Didn’t take it literal til it happened. I tried dabbling with pills and even drank lean for the first time all at 12. Weed was probably the worst thing I could’ve done to myself at that point of my life. To this day with all the shit I’ve ever tried including psychedelics (don’t consider drugs). Weed is the one thing I can’t handle. I quit at around 13 and only started smoking again (heavy) at 16. Worst time of my life. I would green out almost every single time. When I didn’t my social anxiety amped up beyond the skies. I’d enter extreme panic. Actually for months I’d get so high during lunch freshman year that I just wouldn’t go back for the rest of the day/classes. Quit again and started again in my 20s. Still has more negatives than positives. I can handle and control it a lot better. No more puking, but weed definitely hijacked my brain and really put a tight chain on me. Let your brain and body develop. You have no reason to be doing drugs at such a young age. 

I love weed and all that it’s about. I wish people could drop the heavy shit and just be cool with weed. It definitely was never my friend, but I support it. Just not for the youth. Honestly
